# Keylogger Implementation Guide for SEC504: Hacker Techniques, Exploits & Incident Handling

## Overview

This guide provides a detailed technical overview of keylogger implementation, focusing on practical exercises for both Windows and Linux environments. Keyloggers are tools used to capture keystrokes, which can be useful for understanding how attackers gather sensitive information. This guide is intended for educational purposes only and should be used responsibly and ethically.

## Keylogger Basics

A keylogger is a type of surveillance software that records keystrokes made by a user on their keyboard. This can be done through software or hardware methods. In this guide, we will focus on software-based keyloggers implemented in Python for both Windows and Linux.
